It really comes down to where it'll live. A desk globe (like the Explorer 12" Blue Ocean you're looking at) sits comfortably on a desk, shelf, or credenza and adds a nice touch without taking over the room. A floor globe (like the Eureka 16" you also viewed) is more of a statement piece, around waist height, that anchors a room like a library or office corner.

Are you picturing it on a desk/shelf, or as a standalone piece on the floor somewhere?
